input.quote: iii. Licensor hereby, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement and provided that Licensee makes payments to Licensor as required under this Agreement, grants to Licensee a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use and subject to the additional restrictions set forth below and otherwise in this License Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant in Article II runs to the Licensee alone, and the restrictions confine access to "the employees of the Licensee" (p0045), barring disclosure to or use by any other person without Licensor's prior written consent (p0041, p0042). Our Affiliates and the contractors/introducing brokers who operate the Platform on our behalf are therefore excluded, with the only path to add them being Licensor's discretionary consent — short of even the fallback (affiliates covered on written notice). Transferability also fails the fallback: assignment requires Licensor's consent (p0149) and any Change of Control automatically terminates the licence unless Licensor consents, with broad deemed-reasonable grounds to refuse (p0134). Article IV additionally allows immediate termination on "any breach ... of any representation, warranty, covenant and/or obligation" with no cure period or materiality, so the licence is effectively revocable at Licensor's instance. Redline extends the grant to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, confirms successor transfer in an M&A transaction, and limits revocation to uncured material breach; Affiliate coverage on written notice is available as a fallback.

proposal.summary: Extend licence grant to Licensee's Affiliates and contractors, permit assignment to a successor in an M&A transaction, and limit revocation to uncured material breach.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the grant to our Affiliates and to contractors and introducing brokers acting on our behalf, since as drafted use is confined to our own employees with any wider access requiring Licensor consent. We have also confirmed transferability to a successor in an M&A transaction and that the licence is revocable only for material breach left uncured after notice; if helpful, we can accept Affiliate coverage on written notice to Licensor as a fallback.

ops.text: For the avoidance of doubt, references in this Agreement to employees of the Licensee include personnel of Licensee's Affiliates and of contractors and introducing brokers acting on Licensee's behalf, and no separate consent of Licensor is required for their access to or use of the Licensed Technology within the Field of Use, provided that Licensee remains responsible for their compliance with this Agreement. Licensee may assign this Agreement and the license granted hereunder, without Licensor's consent, to a successor in interest in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or equity. The license granted hereunder is not revocable at Licensor's discretion and may be terminated by Licensor only upon a material breach by Licensee that remains uncured thirty (30) days after Licensor's written notice describing the breach.
